trigger: Count observed quantity equal to cutoff book quantity and issue a voucher number
observed: Common commit handoff requires at least one movement and rejects the otherwise valid no-change count
expected: Commit the count claim and audit evidence without inventing quantity or value movements

title: Native movement handoff loses serial identities
trigger: Receive one prepared serial and publish its native movement
observed: StockMovementUnit retains the identity but the report payload contains an empty serial list
expected: Retain verified unit identities and their cost/origin lineage in movement evidence

observed: List returns no positions despite retained stock history and pool quantity; position detail returns 500
expected: Return an explicit recoverable reconciliation failure and preserve evidence visibility

title: Native dispatch has no action breakdown

observed: Outward total is correct but all supplied outward-action columns are zero; dispatch is absent and last-consumption calculation ignores it
expected: Expose all supported native actions and define consumption semantics without equating dispatch with a sale

title: Small nonzero stock is displayed as zero
trigger: Display quantity 0.0010 with company display precision 2
observed: Stock table shows 0.00 with no exact secondary quantity
expected: Preserve the exact quantity or provide an explicit nonzero precision indicator

title: Stock quantities have no base unit
trigger: Read stock for products with different base units
observed: Quantity columns and stock DTOs omit the unit label and base-unit identity
expected: Display the verified historical/base unit beside quantity with field-policy enforcement
